Travel Risk Management & Intelligence

An itinerary-level brief before departure, and eyes on the trip after.

Pre-travel brief 48 to 72 hrs out

Six domains, delivered 48 to 72 hours before departure:

  • Personal Security
  • Cyber & Digital Exposure
  • Health & Medical
  • Geopolitical Risk
  • Criminal & K&R Risk
  • Infrastructure & Logistics

Planning

  • Secure routing
  • Contingency and evacuation planning with safe havens
  • Check-in procedures

During the trip

  • Continuous monitoring
  • Incident alerts

Documentation

ISO 31030-aligned records of the risk assessment and controls.

Event Risk Management & Intelligence

Three phases, from site survey to after-action report.

  1. Before

    • Venue and site vulnerability assessment: access control gaps, surveillance coverage, egress, perimeter
    • Crowd and protest indicators
    • VIP-targeted threat analysis

  2. During

    • Live OSINT and social media monitoring
    • Alerts routed to security and operations leads
    • Embedded or on-call analyst

  3. After

    After-action intelligence report suitable for leadership, legal or insurance review.
